sample.definition: time-indexed prior-game profile BUY records in final five regulation minutes, 5-20 cent own-token price, and own-token P* below 50 percent

profile_definitions.limited_prior_history: under 20 prior NBA-market participant records or under 3 prior NBA games
profile_definitions.high_prior_activity: at least 20 prior records per prior active UTC day, after adequate history
profile_definitions.maker_record_dominant: at least 75 percent prior maker-role records, after high activity rule
profile_definitions.taker_record_dominant: at most 25 percent prior maker-role records, after high activity rule

gap_definitions.price_minus_outcome: execution price minus realized token payoff; positive is realized overpayment
gap_definitions.price_minus_Pstar: execution price minus estimated market-free benchmark
gap_definitions.outcome_minus_Pstar: realized token payoff minus estimated benchmark

estimators.pooled: aggregate weighted numerator divided by aggregate weight; additive profile contributions sum to total
estimators.equal_game: within-game additive contributions averaged equally across games; profile contributions sum to total

bootstrap.method: two-way pigeonhole bootstrap over games and wallets with multiplicative cluster weights; percentile 95 percent intervals

limitations: Accounting contribution and profile association are descriptive; they are not causal effects or counterfactual market-price impact.
Profiles are observable prior-season NBA-market behavior, not verified bot, retail, professional, or market-maker identities.
The unit is a participant-side Activity API BUY record, not a unique matched market transaction; one taker transaction can correspond to multiple maker fill records.
The selected final-five longshot BUY cohort is not representative of all trades or of each wallet's whole portfolio.
Profile-component confidence intervals are exploratory percentile intervals and are not adjusted for the many profile, weighting, outcome, and estimator combinations.
price minus realized payoff is noisy one-season calibration, not by itself an ex-ante mispricing measure.
P* is estimated and is not the true probability.

No historical 2025-26 Polymarket order-book midpoint series is assembled in this project; a third-party vendor advertises minute-level L2 history from August 2025, but coverage and licensing have not been audited. Comparable Kalshi wallet identities are unavailable.
